text:
kassandra: hey team, quick orientation question on day 1 — where do I drop tiny infra questions (e.g., missing repo access) versus "who owns x" process questions? also how do I silence onboarding reminders for the week if i want less noise? :wave:

jono: welcome Kassandra! Short rules i follow: repo/access -> #dev-access or DM the owner; if it's a general "who owns" that affects multiple teams, post in #new-hires; team-specific ops -> your team channel. For infra outages or customer impact, use #incidents.

it-ops-bot: To create a tracked access request use the access repo flow or `/ticket create "access request" --body "repos: infra/*"`. For diagnostics use `diag collect` and attach. Typical SLA: 2 business hours for access requests.

samir: about the onboarding pings: DM @onboarding-bot `snooze 7d` to pause reminders for 7 days, or `snooze until 2026-04-15` for a specific date. You can also tune which reminders you get in the bot's DM menu. If you only want daily rollups, ask the bot for `digest mode`.

kassandra: nice — is there a preference for posting multiple small unrelated questions in one message vs separate threads? want to avoid spamming the channel.

jono: bundle tiny related questions in one message. If it's more than 2 replies long, start a new thread. Use reactions for simple acks ( :eyes: , :thumbsup: ) to avoid filler messages. If the question is private (pay, schedule), DM or use #people-ops.

hr-ops: etiquette note: introductions are great in #introductions. Include timezone, team, role, and which repos/services you'll need. Folks usually add you to onboarding groups within a day. Also ask for any manager-specific onboarding tasks directly to your manager or the onboarding checklist.

samir: one more tip: check pinned messages and the channel topic before asking — links to the access flow, infra docs, and common PR templates live there. Also prefix your message with a short subject like "access: infra repos" when posting to #new-hires so people can scan quickly.

kassandra: thanks all — posting intro now (UTC-7, infra eng, needs access to infra/*). snoozing onboarding-bot for 5 days with `snooze 5d`. appreciate it :thumbsup:
